description.it: Atlante anatomico 3D interattivo di spalla, gomito, polso, dito, anca e ginocchio: ossa, muscoli, legamenti, vasi e nervi con note radiologiche.
description.en: Interactive 3D anatomy atlas of the shoulder, elbow, wrist, finger, hip and knee: bones, muscles, ligaments, vessels and nerves with radiology notes.

image_alt.it: MSK Atlas — Atlante anatomico 3D: polso con muscoli, tendini, vasi e nervi
image_alt.en: MSK Atlas — 3D anatomy atlas: wrist with muscles, tendons, vessels and nerves

testi.Anatomia muscolo-scheletrica da esplorar: Musculoskeletal anatomy to explore in three dimensions.
testi.Dal nome alla struttura 3D, con le ossa: From the name to the 3D structure, with the reference bones.
testi.Dal tubercolo dello scafoide e dalla cre: From the scaphoid tubercle and the trapezium ridge to the pisiform and the hook of the hamate: roof of the carpal tunnel.
testi.Ogni tavola è un modello tridimensionale: Each plate is a three-dimensional model to rotate, take apart layer by layer and consult structure by structure, with anatomical and radiological notes. Right in the browser, smartphones included.
testi.Tavole interattive: spalla, gomito, pols: Interactive plates: shoulder, elbow, wrist, finger, hip, knee, each a standalone page
testi.Strutture anatomiche con scheda: ossa, l: Anatomical structures with details: bones, ligaments, muscles, vessels and nerves
testi.Rotazione libera, zoom e strati da mostr: Free rotation, zoom and layers to show or hide
testi.Scegli un distretto oppure <a href=\"#st: Choose a region or search for a structure.
testi.Anteprima del modello 3D della spalla de: Preview of the 3D model of the right shoulder, anterior view
testi.Anteprima del modello 3D del gomito dest: Preview of the 3D model of the right elbow, anterior view
testi.Anteprima del modello 3D del polso destr: Preview of the 3D model of the right wrist, palmar view
testi.Anteprima del modello 3D del dito medio: Preview of the 3D model of the right middle finger, oblique palmar view
testi.Anteprima del modello 3D dell’anca destr: Preview of the 3D model of the right hip, anterior view
testi.Anteprima del modello 3D del ginocchio d: Preview of the 3D model of the right knee, anterior view
testi.Anteprima del modello 3D della caviglia: Preview of the 3D model of the right ankle, anterolateral view
testi.Hai notato qualcosa da correggere o hai: Spotted something to fix or have an idea to share? Choose how to write to me.
testi.Un dettaglio anatomico, un testo da corr: An anatomical detail, a text to correct or a technical problem: every report helps.
testi.Suggerimenti, uso dell’atlante nella did: Suggestions, using the atlas in teaching or proposals for collaboration. You can contact me directly here.
testi.Medico specialista in Radiodiagnostica ·: Specialist in Diagnostic Radiology · Author of MSK Atlas
testi.Per informazioni sul progetto, suggerime: For information about the project, suggestions and collaborations. The form is not intended for medical consultation requests.
testi.Scrivi il nome qui sopra o nel campo di: Type the name above or in the search field of a model: the structure opens already selected, isolated with the bones and centered.
testi.Trascina per ruotare, pizzica o usa la r: Drag to rotate, pinch or use the scroll wheel to zoom. To move the model: two fingers on a touch screen, right button or Shift + drag with the mouse.
testi.L’ellisse sotto la «i» ruota con il mode: The ellipse under the “i” rotates with the model and shows Ant, Post, Lat and Med: tap a side to view it head-on. In the elbow and wrist, ⇅ flips the limb.
testi.Tocca una struttura o il suo nome nell’e: Tap a structure or its name in the list: anatomical and radiological note, with origin, insertion and function for muscles and ligaments. On smartphones it expands upward and closes with a downward swipe.
testi.Mostra o nascondi le categorie, isola un: Show or hide categories, isolate a structure with the bones, make the muscles transparent or leave only the bones. Where available, guided Regions show the area with a cut plane; “Reset” returns to the full model.
testi.Aggiungi MSK Atlas alla schermata Home:: Add MSK Atlas to your Home Screen: it opens with a tap on the icon, full screen and without the browser bars. An internet connection is still required.
testi.Tocca <strong>Condividi</strong> (il qua: Tap Share (the square with the upward arrow; in recent versions it is in the ⋯ menu next to the address).
testi.Scorri l'elenco e scegli <strong>Aggiung: Scroll the list and choose Add to Home Screen.
testi.Se compare l'opzione per aprirlo come ap: If the option to open it as a web app appears, leave it on, then tap Add.
testi.Da iOS 16.4 funziona anche da Chrome ed: Since iOS 16.4 it also works from Chrome and Edge, again from the Share menu.
testi.Tocca il menu <strong>⋮</strong> in alto: Tap the ⋮ menu at the top right.
testi.Scegli <strong>Aggiungi a schermata Home: Choose Add to Home screen (or Install app) and confirm with Install.
testi.L'icona di MSK Atlas compare nella scher: The MSK Atlas icon appears on the Home screen and in the app list.
testi.Con altri browser, come Samsung Internet: In other browsers, such as Samsung Internet, the option is in the main menu.
